items.title: Formal etaleness restricts to open subschemes of source and base
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)

items.difficulty_reason: If f : X -> S is formally etale, then the restriction f|_U : U -> V to open subschemes with f(U) contained in V is formally etale. The retained proof runs the definition: for a solid diagram with a first-order thickening i : T -> T', formal ramifiedness (uniqueness part of formal etaleness) yields a unique S-morphism a' : T' -> X extending a, and since the underlying spaces of T and T' agree, a' factors through U, giving the unique dotted arrow into U. Retained author proof at lines 1580-1592.
